description: Updates specified attributes of an existing Sentry issue within a Sentry organization, leaving other attributes unchanged.

inputSchema.description: Request payload for updating attributes of a Sentry issue.

assignedTo.description: Actor ID (e.g., 'user:1', 'team:2'), username, or email for assignment. Omit, or use an empty string or 'null' equivalent, to unassign.
assignedTo.title: Assigned To

hasSeen.description: Updates if the user has seen the issue (true for seen, false for unseen).
hasSeen.title: Has Seen

isBookmarked.description: Updates the user's bookmark for the issue (true to bookmark, false to remove).
isBookmarked.title: Is Bookmarked

isPublic.description: Sets the issue's visibility (true for public, false for private).
isPublic.title: Is Public

isSubscribed.description: Updates the user's notification subscription for the issue (true to subscribe, false to unsubscribe).
isSubscribed.title: Is Subscribed

issue_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue to be updated.
issue_id.title: Issue Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

status.description: The new status to assign to the issue. Valid values: "resolved", "resolvedInNextRelease", "unresolved", "ignored".
status.title: Status

statusDetails__inCommit.description: The commit hash associated with the fix for this issue.
statusDetails__inCommit.title: Status Details  In Commit

statusDetails__inNextRelease.description: Specifies if the issue is resolved in the next Sentry release.
statusDetails__inNextRelease.title: Status Details  In Next Release

statusDetails__inRelease.description: The Sentry release version in which the issue is considered resolved.
statusDetails__inRelease.title: Status Details  In Release

name: update_issue_attributes_in_organization

AssignedTo.description: Information about the user or team assigned to an issue.

email.description: Email address of the assigned user (if applicable).
email.title: Email

id.description: Unique identifier of the assigned user or team.
id.title: Id

name.description: Display name of the assigned user or team.
name.title: Name

AssignedTo.title: AssignedTo

Metadata.title: Metadata

Project.description: Information about the project an issue belongs to.
Project.title: Project

annotations.description: Array of annotations associated with this issue.
annotations.title: Annotations

assignedTo.description: Information about the user or team assigned to this issue, or null if unassigned.
assignedTo.title: Assigned To

count.description: Total number of times this issue has occurred.
count.title: Count

culprit.description: The suspected cause or location of the issue (e.g., 'raven.scripts.runner in main').
culprit.title: Culprit

firstSeen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the issue was first seen.
firstSeen.title: First Seen

hasSeen.description: Whether the current user has viewed this issue.
hasSeen.title: Has Seen

isBookmarked.description: Whether the current user has bookmarked this issue.
isBookmarked.title: Is Bookmarked

isPublic.description: Whether the issue is publicly accessible.
isPublic.title: Is Public

isSubscribed.description: Whether the current user is subscribed to workflow notifications for this issue.
isSubscribed.title: Is Subscribed

lastSeen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the issue was last seen.
lastSeen.title: Last Seen

logger.description: Name of the logger that recorded this issue, or null if not specified.
logger.title: Logger

numComments.description: Number of comments on this issue.
numComments.title: Num Comments

permalink.description: Direct URL to view this issue in the Sentry web interface.
permalink.title: Permalink

project.description: Information about the project this issue belongs to.
project.title: Project

shareId.description: Identifier for public sharing of this issue, or null if not publicly shared.
shareId.title: Share Id

shortId.description: Human-readable short identifier for the issue (e.g., 'PUMP-STATION-1').
shortId.title: Short Id

status.description: Current status of the issue. Valid values: 'resolved', 'unresolved', 'ignored'.
status.title: Status

statusDetails.description: Additional details about the issue status, including resolution information. Can contain fields like inRelease, inNextRelease, inCommit, ignoreCount, ignoreWindow, ignoreUserCount, ignoreUserWindow, ignoreDuration.
statusDetails.title: Status Details

subscriptionDetails.description: Details about the current user's subscription to this issue, or null if not subscribed.
subscriptionDetails.title: Subscription Details

title.description: The title or description of the issue.
title.title: Title

userCount.description: Number of unique users affected by this issue.
userCount.title: User Count
